name: Sequence Diagram
description: A sequence diagram plugin using JointJS and CodeMirror

aiContext.documentContext:
DevScribe Sequence Diagram Specification:
You are generating an interactive Sequence Diagram showing the step-by-step message exchange and lifecycle flow between components.

OUTPUT FORMAT RULES:
1. Output MUST be the raw Sequence Diagram DSL text.
2. Do NOT wrap the code in markdown code fences (do NOT use ```sequence or ```).
3. Do NOT include conversational preamble or explanation outside the diagram code.

SYNTAX RULES:
1. DEFINING COMPONENTS
Declare your participants at the top of the diagram:
actor User as Customer
participant Web as Web App
database DB as Database
Custom Styling: Provide background, border, and text colors inside brackets:
actor User [bg: #eff6ff, border: #3b82f6, color: #1e40af]
participant App as Web App [bg: #fcf7f2, border: #f97316, color: #9a3412]
participant API as Gateway Service [bg: #f0fdf4, border: #22c55e, color: #166534]
database DB as Primary Database [bg: #fdf2f8, border: #ec4899, color: #9d174d]

2. DEFINING ARROWS
Solid Arrow (Request / Synch):
User ->> Web: Place order
or
User -> Web: Place order
Dashed Arrow (Response / Return):
Web -->> User: Show confirmation
or
Web --> User: Show confirmation
Custom Colors & Flow Animation:
User -> App: Enter credentials [moving: true]
App -> API: POST /auth/login (user, pass) [color: #4f46e5, moving: true]

3. ACTIVATION RECORDS
Show when a component is actively processing a request:
activate Web [bg: #eff6ff, border: #3b82f6]
deactivate Web

4. CONDITIONAL BLOCKS
Wrap messages in alt/else segments to show logical choices:
alt in stock
  API -> DB: Query
else out of stock
  API --> User: Error
end

5. NOTE BLOCKS
Add annotations over or relative to lifelines:
note over API: Process data
note left of Web: Validate [bg: #fef9c3]

Example:
title: Authentication & Query Flow

actor User [bg: #eff6ff, border: #3b82f6, color: #1e40af]
participant App as Web App [bg: #fcf7f2, border: #f97316, color: #9a3412]
participant API as Gateway Service [bg: #f0fdf4, border: #22c55e, color: #166534]
database DB as Primary Database [bg: #fdf2f8, border: #ec4899, color: #9d174d]

User -> App: Enter username & password [moving: true]
App -> API: POST /auth/login (user, pass) [color: #4f46e5, moving: true]
activate API [bg: #22c55e, border: #166534]

note over API: Validate credentials\nand hash passwords [bg: #fef9c3, border: #eab308, color: #713f12]

API -> DB: Query user profile record [color: #22c55e, moving: true]
activate DB [bg: #ec4899, border: #9d174d]
DB --> API: Return user profile data [color: #64748b, moving: true]
deactivate DB

API -> API: Verify security hash [moving: true]

alt Success
  API --> App: 200 OK (JWT Access Token) [color: #22c55e, moving: true]
else Failure
  API --> App: 401 Unauthorized [color: #ef4444, moving: true]
end

deactivate API
App --> User: Render dashboard interface [color: #4f46e5, moving: true]
